task:
UI redesign phase 5b — Review/export pop-out over the plan, per-item unresolved-information links and explicit DRAFT export (plan: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-02-v3-ui-redesign-plan.md`, on main, §4 row P5b and "Phase 5 — Plan and Review/export"). START from current `main`: it already contains P5a (#1003: System layout / Build order tabs in `apps/web/src/lib/features/plan/tabs.ts` + `PlanWorkspace.svelte`, the facility preview with explicit Add to plan, and the design kit #998). apps/web only; no backend, route, API or export-FORMAT change.

WHAT TO BUILD:
1. Add `apps/web/src/lib/features/plan/ReviewExport.svelte` — a pop-out (use the kit pop-out skin already used by the Inspect evidence pop-out and the P5a facility preview; non-modal, Close button, Escape closes, focus returns to the opener, topmost-Escape only) opened from a **Review & export** action in the plan header area. It shows, over the CURRENT plan (reads the existing plan model/evaluation — no new calculations, no new API calls): the plan's summary (system, item counts, Tier 2 and Tier 3 balances kept SEPARATE for Now and After the plan, exactly as `SummaryPane` presents them), and a per-item list of unresolved information: every unknown slot, body with missing data, prediction-only surface slot (keep its source label), and blocked/invalid build-order item that the existing evaluation already reports. Each item is a link/button that closes nothing it need not, activates the right task tab (System layout for body/slot editors, Build order for builds) via the P5a tab helper, scrolls the relevant editor/build into view and moves keyboard focus to it (reuse the existing first-blocked / first-unknown focus shortcuts' targeting code rather than duplicating it; those shortcuts remain). Review never states or implies build eligibility — use the existing wording about checks/rules and unknowns; do not add 'eligible', 'approved', 'ready to build' or similar.
2. DRAFT export: the existing `Export plan` download (`download()` in `PlanWorkspace.svelte`, `exportPlan(model)` in `model.ts` / codec) becomes explicitly **Export DRAFT plan**; the downloaded filename becomes `colony-plan-DRAFT-<systemId>.json`; inside the JSON keep `cpe_plan_export_v1` and the existing schema EXACTLY as is (the import side must accept both old and new files unchanged) — if a DRAFT marker is added to the artifact, add it ONLY as an additive optional field that the importer ignores and that the roundtrip test proves does not change the imported model; do not bump the format version. Place the export action inside the Review/export pop-out and keep it reachable from the header (same button or a clearly labelled one); the DRAFT word must appear in the button, the aria-label and the filename.
3. Home (`routes/+page.svelte`): ONLY replace the current “Review & export — Coming later” wording with truthful wording that the Plan tool now offers Review & export (no fourth tool, no new route; the rest of home polish is P6a, not this PR).
4. Styles via kit tokens only (`design-kit.test.ts` must pass); `plan.css` additions for the pop-out list are fine.

TESTS: Vitest — `ReviewExport.test.ts` (opens/closes, Escape, focus return, lists each unresolved item kind from a fixture plan with unknown slot + prediction-only surface slot + blocked build, each link activates the right tab and focuses the editor/build, T2/T3 separation preserved, no eligibility wording); `PlanWorkspace.test.ts` (Review & export action, DRAFT export filename and button text, export→import roundtrip equals original model for both an old-format fixture and a newly exported file); `model`/codec tests for the roundtrip; keep every existing test and `data-*` hook working. Product `apps/web/cypress/e2e/plan.cy.ts`: extend the existing P5a journey with review unknowns → per-item link focuses the editor → DRAFT export (assert the download filename contains DRAFT) → import → reload, plus axe on the open pop-out and reduced motion; keep its runtime bounded. Contract pins: `tests/test_v3_product_journey_contract.py` and any plan/docs contract test that pins plan wording — update pins to the new contract where the change is intentional, never loosen them. Update plan doc §4 rows P5b to "implemented in this PR" and the Phase 6 note about the home wording, and add a CHANGES.md line under the unreleased section.

RULES: pnpm 11.25.0, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, then `pnpm check`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build` must all pass before you push (run `pnpm format` if needed); run the Python contract tests you touched. Do not touch `frontend/`, backend, sql/, workflows, deploy/ or scripts/. Do not create a flat `apps/web/src/lib/api.ts`. No new dependencies. Raven import, browser-kept plans, plan ownership and the F4 flag stay exactly as they are. In the PR body list the unresolved-item kinds covered, the exact export filename, and confirm the import of a pre-P5b export file is unchanged.
